title: Enriching Datasets with Demographics through Large Language Models: What’s in a Name?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-predicted birth dates and ages from names against ground truth using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) to identify mode collapse (predicting round numbers like 1900 or 1990) and skews toward younger ages.
Evaluating the accuracy of zero-shot race prediction from names and analyzing performance disparities and misclassifications across different demographic groups (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic, Asian).

Measuring nationality prediction accuracy from names and analyzing the models' over-representation and over-prediction of Western, English-speaking countries (particularly American) while underperforming on others, such as Latin American names.
Assessing zero-shot gender prediction accuracy from names across various racial groups and noting the models' interaction with heavily male-skewed historical datasets.
